ItemID: NA; Title: The Blessed Hellride; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy riffs fit my hard-rock listening, but other albums interest me more this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, abrasive sound feels less appealing right now than the melodic heaviness in my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Master of Puppets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose its intricate riffs and powerful metal sound given my interest in heavy, technically engaging music.
ItemID: NA; Title: Aenima       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently listened to 10.000 Days, I would choose another Tool album for its atmosphere and complex rhythms.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Sound of Perseverance; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its technical metal approach interests me given my heavier listening, but I would save it for another session.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dirt       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its dark mood and heavy guitars fit my taste, though Tool is the stronger draw today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Antichrist Superstar       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its industrial edge is less aligned with the progressive and melodic metal I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Source Tags & Codes; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its art-rock direction is less suited to my current appetite for heavier metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ride the Lightning; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its thrash riffs appeal to me, but I would pick Master of Puppets first this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic rock sound has some overlap with my history, but I want more intricate, riff-driven music today.
